name: sentrypeer
summary: Protect SIP Servers from bad actors.
highlights: -f — Set 'sentrypeer.db' location or use SENTRYPEER_DB_FILE env
-j — Enable json logging or use SENTRYPEER_JSON_LOG env
-p — Enable Peer to Peer mode or use SENTRYPEER_PEER_TO_PEER env
-b — Set Peer to Peer bootstrap node or use SENTRYPEER_BOOTSTRAP_NODE env
-i — Set OAuth 2 client ID or use SENTRYPEER_OAUTH2_CLIENT_ID env to get a Bearer token for Web
-c — Set OAuth 2 client secret or use SENTRYPEER_OAUTH2_CLIENT_SECRET env to get a Bearer token
-a — Enable RESTful API mode or use SENTRYPEER_API env
-w — Set WebHook URL for bad actor json POSTs or use SENTRYPEER_WEBHOOK_URL env

flags.name: -f
flags.description: Set 'sentrypeer.db' location or use SENTRYPEER_DB_FILE env

flags.name: -j
flags.description: Enable json logging or use SENTRYPEER_JSON_LOG env

flags.name: -p
flags.description: Enable Peer to Peer mode or use SENTRYPEER_PEER_TO_PEER env

flags.name: -b
flags.description: Set Peer to Peer bootstrap node or use SENTRYPEER_BOOTSTRAP_NODE env

flags.name: -i
flags.description: Set OAuth 2 client ID or use SENTRYPEER_OAUTH2_CLIENT_ID env to get a Bearer token for WebHook

flags.name: -c
flags.description: Set OAuth 2 client secret or use SENTRYPEER_OAUTH2_CLIENT_SECRET env to get a Bearer token for WebHook

flags.name: -a
flags.description: Enable RESTful API mode or use SENTRYPEER_API env

flags.name: -w
flags.description: Set WebHook URL for bad actor json POSTs or use SENTRYPEER_WEBHOOK_URL env

flags.name: -r
flags.description: Enable SIP responsive mode or use SENTRYPEER_SIP_RESPONSIVE env

flags.name: -R
flags.description: Disable SIP mode completely or use SENTRYPEER_SIP_DISABLE env

flags.name: -l
flags.description: Set JSON logfile (default './sentrypeer_json.log') location or use SENTRYPEER_JSON_LOG_FILE env

flags.name: -N

flags.name: -t

flags.name: -k
flags.description: Set TLS key location (default './key.pem') or use SENTRYPEER_KEY env

flags.name: -z
flags.description: Set TLS listen address (default '0.0.0.0:5061') or use SENTRYPEER_TLS_LISTEN_ADDRESS env

flags.name: -s
flags.description: Enable syslog logging or use SENTRYPEER_SYSLOG env

flags.name: -v
flags.description: Enable verbose logging or use SENTRYPEER_VERBOSE env

flags.name: -d
